4季ぶりの1部で4位から9位へ――Wasedaア式の2026 season

Waseda returned to the Kanto first division after four seasons away. 前期は4位で折り返したが、実際の開催日順では5連敗も経験した。This English Mix follows all 17 league results, the national cup disappointment, and the 3-0 win over Toin Yokohama, while separating facts from interpretations.
